findings.claimAffected: The Stage 3E logistic router is evaluated from the exact 51-feature runtime contract and is bound to its frozen hash.

evidence.frozenModelFormat: lr-model.json {keys[51] sorted, mu[51], sd[51], w[52]}; w[i] is the weight of keys[i]; w[51] is the bias
evidence.runtimeRead: bias = w[0]; weight of keys[i] = w[i+1]

findings.correction: bias = w[keys.length]; feature weight i = w[i]; w.length === keys.length + 1 asserted; incomplete or non-finite input fails closed with no route

causes: reward V1 vs V2 immediate scalars
one-step V1 vector vs frozen horizon-rollout greedy vector
runtime candidate substituted for genuine V2B answer

findings.correction: Deployable runtime features are relabeled DEPLOYABLE_RUNTIME_MODE and are not claimed as Stage 3E parity. DEPLOYABLE_STAGE3E_FEATURE_PARITY=false; DEPLOYABLE_RUNTIME_FEATURE_CONTRACT_REQUIRES_REDESIGN=true. A diagnostic REFERENCE_PARITY_MODE harness proves historical parity; it is not the runtime.

findings.claimAffected: OBSERVATION -> WORLD_STATE -> CALIBRATION -> TRACE -> INCUMBENT -> LEDGER -> OUTCOME -> SHADOW_EXPERIENCE -> VALIDATION -> ELIGIBILITY for every step

evidence.mechanism: attachLedgerCounterfactual(candidateAction = null) threw in Stage 3F.3 canonicalAction; the ledger closure never assigned, experience creation in the same block never ran, and the step was reported PARTIAL_EVIDENCE

findings.correction: An abstained recommendation attaches no counterfactual; ledger (NO_SENTINEL_PROPOSAL), selected action, veto, experience, validation, and eligibility for every purpose are preserved; ledger evaluation is INCOMPARABLE; prediction-dependent profiles are INELIGIBLE with DECISION_TIME_PREDICTION_REQUIRED

evidence.effect: With the corrected router the original seed abstains, so the certified campaign would have produced NO_SENTINEL_RECOMMENDATION instead of DIFFERENT_ACTION and the abstention would have lost its ledger.

findings.correction: Remediated campaign DISAGREEMENT uses seed 12, the first seed >= 11 in prime/adversarial_choice level 1 where the corrected router proposes an action (score 0.9131). The seed-11 abstention is retained as remediation evidence.
